title: Chapter 134 Acquaintance
content:
Chapter 134 Acquaintance

Bang bang bang!

Several heavy muffled sounds sounded, the hero saved the beauty, and the young man beat the villain away, and the scene of the beauty returning home did not happen.

反而是少年被直接打趴在了地上。

“呸！什么玩意！”

"I'm so laughing to death. I really think I have some strength. That's it?"

"Haha, no one dares to save the beauty by heroes."

The big men sarcastically said a few words to the young man who was lying on the ground and was already unconscious, and then looked at Yan Lingyun who was still standing in the distance.

"Oh, you haven't run away yet. You don't really think that kid can beat us, right?"

"Hehehe, boss, I think this girl probably wants that."

这时，另一人一脸淫笑的开口道。

几人嘴脸可谓是邪恶至极。

At this moment, they did not realize Yan Lingyun's increasingly cold face at all.

“你们几个说够了吗？”

The extremely cold words came from Yan Lingyun's mouth.

When they heard Yan Lingyun's words, for some reason, the few people suddenly felt a little trembling all over.

"you,,"

At this time, a breath had already surged out of Yan Lingyun's body.

Feeling the suffocating terrifying aura, the few people's faces turned pale.

完了！

踢到铁板了。

......

翌日，陆道生缓缓苏醒了过来。

"Hell, how come your head hurts so much."

He shook his head suddenly, and then Lu Daosheng realized that he had returned home at some point.

Looking at everything that is familiar and unfamiliar around you.

Lu Daosheng sighed deeply.

If all this was a dream.

I was drunk and woke up for no reason and traveled through time.

At the beginning, he was still very excited, fantasizing that he would become a peerless and powerful man, and be arbitrary forever, like the protagonists in those novels, he would push forward all the way and become a legendary existence.

However, these are just fantasies after all.

The reality is that I don’t have anything to do, and I’m still wearing it, even my cultivation qualifications are very rubbish.

That's all in this life.

Over time, I got used to it.

You will naturally work hard. Whatever you can do, it depends on your fate.

At this time, Lu Daosheng suddenly remembered that he seemed to be brave last night.

But after that, he couldn't remember it.

When I got up and got out of bed, a strong sense of pain suddenly came from my whole body.

"Hiss~"

Lu Daosheng took a breath, then endured the pain and slowly came outside.

Everything is the same.

My own courtyard, my own house.

The courtyard is very simple, a small pavilion built by itself, and it has opened up some places and planted some fruits and melons.

After sniffing, Lu Daosheng continued to walk outside.

"Xiao Lu, you guys can do it."

When I walked outside, I soon met an acquaintance.

Looking at the other party's meaningful smiling face, Lu Daosheng was a little confused.

what happened.

However, when I wanted to ask questions, the other party had already left.

"Hey hey, Xiao Lu, come here."

At this time, an old lady selling breakfast waved to Lu Daosheng.

Seeing this, Lu Daosheng walked over suspiciously.

"Aunt Liu, what's wrong?"

The small village where I live is just a somewhat remote village.

Most of the villages are ordinary people, and practitioners only occupy a very small number.

Lu Daosheng is one of the few, but he has just entered the cultivation level and has only become one of the first levels of qi cultivation. He is considered the lowest-strength cultivator.

Usually, some extremely strong men can beat him.

When he walked to the aunt, Aunt Liu immediately smiled and said, "Xiao Lu, tell Auntie, what is the relationship between that little girl and you last night?"

听到这话，陆道生顿时懵了片刻。

Little girl?

Wait, remember.

I seemed like a hero saving the beauty last night.

Later, later,

Hiss, what happened later? I can't remember it no matter what.

But Lu Daosheng doesn't care. He thinks that he should have successfully beaten the other party away, and then he was a little injured. In the end, he became drunk and became unconscious.

Then the girl brought herself back.

Well, that must be the case, otherwise how could I return home safely?

In just a moment, Lu Daosheng sorted out this matter.

"Aunt Liu, is that girl gone?"

Without answering Aunt Liu's question, Lu Daosheng asked.

Upon hearing this, Aunt Liu smiled even happier and pointed behind Lu Daosheng, "Xiao Lu, isn't that right behind you?"

As soon as these words came out, Lu Daosheng trembled all over.

Turning around, he immediately found a beautiful woman standing in front of him, looking at her with a smile.

"Are you awake?"

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng's face was a little red for some reason, and then nodded slightly.

"you,,"

Lu Daosheng was about to say something, but Yan Lingyun stepped forward and handed Lu Daosheng a bag of herbs.

"You were injured last night, so I'll buy some medicine for you."

Looking at the herbs in his hand, Lu Daosheng was stunned.

At this time, Aunt Liu behind her was already smiling from ear to ear.

"That girl, Xiao Lu is in bad health. Since he is injured, then go back and apply medicine as soon as possible. It will be bad if the disease is left behind."

Immediately, Aunt Liu pushed Lu Daosheng directly, her eyes kept indicating.

Lu Daosheng naturally lived up to Aunt Liu's help.

"Well, girl, why don't you come to my house and sit down."

Hearing this, Yan Lingyun did not refuse, and nodded directly: "Okay."

Then, the two walked shoulder to shoulder towards the direction of home.

Along the way, I don't know how many young people envied them.

Soon, the two returned to Lu Daosheng's home.

"Girl, last night,"

Lu Daosheng hesitated and said first.

"It's okay, I have dealt with those people."

Yan Lingyun replied.

"Really? That's great, huh??"

Suddenly, Lu Daosheng was a little confused.

At the same time, some memories suddenly emerged from his mind.

Damn, it's embarrassing.

I seem to have lost face.

At this moment, he was a little afraid to face Yan Lingyun.

After a long time, I was redundant.

"Well, sorry."

If it weren't for me, the other party would have been dealt with long ago.

Oh, it's all because of the wine.

However, Yan Lingyun shook her head, "Your injury is more important, apply the medicine first."

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng looked at the herbs in his hand.

He was looking for trouble, and then this beautiful woman not only solved the problem, but also sent him back and gave him herbs.

For a moment, Lu Daosheng was a little overwhelmed.

However, looking at Lu Daosheng's indifferent look, Yan Lingyun misunderstood his meaning.

"Do you need my help?"

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng was stunned, "This, this is not good, ah ha ha, then trouble you."

Seeing Lu Daosheng like this, Yan Lingyun smiled.

It must be said that this beating was really not in vain.

Lu Daosheng successfully met Yan Lingyun.

And from this time on, the relationship between the two gradually became deeper, until a drunken night later, which completely broke the window paper.
